# Academic Dictionaries and Encyclopedias

> > Comprehensive multilingual reference portal providing access to specialized dictionaries, encyclopedias, and academic knowledge bases across diverse fields including religion, language, medicine, and general reference.

This platform aggregates content from major reference works including English Wikipedia, Catholic Encyclopedia, Encyclopedia of Protestantism, The King James Bible, Easton's Bible Dictionary, Wiktionary, Moby Thesaurus, and The Collaborative International Dictionary of English. It serves as a centralized hub for academic research, linguistic study, and specialized terminology lookup across multiple domains.

## Key Topics

- English Wikipedia
- Universalium
- Catholic Encyclopedia
- Encyclopedia of Protestantism
- The King James Bible
- Easton's Bible Dictionary
- Wiktionary
- Moby Thesaurus
- The Collaborative International Dictionary of English
- Multilingual reference resources
- Specialized dictionaries
- Academic knowledge bases
- Medical terminology
- Religious encyclopedias
- Regional dialects and colloquialisms

## Main Portal

- [Academic Dictionaries and Encyclopedias](https://dic.en-academic.com/): Homepage portal for academic dictionaries and encyclopedias including Wikipedia

- [snappin](https://colloquialisms.en-academic.com/4314/snappin): British slang definition for Stoke-on-Trent regional dialect term

- [FHH](https://abbrev_en.en-academic.com/10754/FHH): Abbreviation entry defining FHH (medical, German institutions)
